mapper.select: SELECT o.salesman_id AS "salesmanId", i.material_id AS "materialId", m.category AS "category", SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_RETURN' THEN -i.qty ELSE i.qty END) AS "qty", SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_RETURN' THEN -(i.amount - i.tax_amount) ELSE i.amount - i.tax_amount END) AS "net" FROM scm_trade_doc d JOIN scm_trade_doc_item i ON i.doc_id = d.id JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = d.order_id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE d.kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND d.biz_date >= #{begin} AND d.biz_date <= #{end} AND o.salesman_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.salesman_id, i.material_id, m.category

SELECT o.salesman_id AS "salesmanId", SUM(si.amount) AS "amount" FROM fin_settlement s JOIN fin_settlement_item si ON si.settlement_id = s.id JOIN fin_bill b ON b.id = si.bill_id JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.id = b.source_id JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = d.order_id WHERE s.kind = 'RECEIPT' AND s.status = 'APPROVED' AND s.settle_date >= #{begin} AND s.settle_date <= #{end} AND b.source_type IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND o.salesman_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.salesman_id
SELECT l.*, u.nickname AS salesman_name FROM fin_commission_line l LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.salesman_id WHERE l.commission_id = #{commissionId} ORDER BY l.final_amount DESC, l.id
SELECT r.*, u.nickname AS salesman_name FROM fin_commission_rule r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.salesman_id ORDER BY r.basis, r.salesman_id, r.material_category, r.threshold
